newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Figueres, Aleman to meet on immigration in April.
newsitem.headline: Figueres, Aleman to meet on immigration in April.

text.p: Costa Rican President Jose Maria Figueres will meet Nicaraguan President Arnoldo Aleman on April 19 and 20 to discuss the problem of illegal immigration between the countries, a Costa Rican official said on Monday.

Costa Rica's ambassador to Nicaragua, Edgar Ugalde, told reporters the presidents, accompanied by delegations of local officials from border regions, will meet in the Nicaraguan city of Granada, 28 miles (45 kms) southeast of the capital Managua.
Among the issues discussed will be border control, migration, security, tourism, drug trafficking and the environment, Ugalde said.
Leda Vargas, Costa Rica's director for immigration on the northern border, said on Sunday that Costa Rica had deported 7,000 illegal Nicaraguans in the first three months of 1997.
Costa Rica says 450,000 Nicaraguans are in the country illegally, often working in agriculture, construction or as domestic employees.
Nicaragua, with a population of 4.3 million, shares a porous, 200-mile (320 km) border with Costa Rica.
